interruption.reason: The workspace package-lock.json changed during the sixth process after an unrelated Tabs repin. Only the first four runs are included; each had passed the orchestrator source, dependency and package checks before the next run began.
interruption.provenance: Aggregated after interruption from the four completed raw renderer/model reports and retained immutable source/package snapshots. Input hashes were recomputed from those snapshots.

reports.label: native
reports.timing: Synchronous command, grammar settlement, explicit DOM/layout update and timer turn delay. Excludes fixture setup, verification, clipboard IPC and physical frame paint.

methodology.includes: TextBuffer transactions/history and TextEditor model selections/display-layer notifications
methodology.excludes: DOM updates, rendering, idle indexing, native clipboard transfer, paste providers, syntax parsing
methodology.comparison: One editor source snapshot per process; alternate serial runs to limit drift

workload.read: snapshot line iterator, or legacy getLines on the native reference

results.memoryNote: GC-delimited process deltas with 21 source snapshots retained; includes forced GC in this case's elapsed time. RSS is allocator-dependent.
